title: Timken Earns Recognition on Forbes America's Best Companies 2027 List

body_markdown:
NORTH CANTON, Ohio


, Nov. 12, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- The Timken Company (NYSE: TKR;[www.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821306-1&h=1899308766&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.timken.com%2F&a=www.timken.com) ), a leader in advanced motion technology, today announced that it has been named to[Forbes America's Best Companies 2027](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821306-1&h=2855935064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.forbes.com%2Flists%2Fbest-companies%2F&a=Forbes+America%27s+Best+Companies+2027) list.


"Being recognized as one of America's best companies acknowledges the outstanding contributions of the people who drive Timken forward," said Natasha Pollock, senior vice president and chief human resources officer. "We're a learning organization, where employees are empowered to grow, turn new ideas into impact and work together to solve our customers' biggest challenges. Our people exemplify the teamwork, expertise and dedication to excellence that fuel our profitable growth."


That commitment is reflected in the execution of Timken's *Elevate to Outperform* strategy and advancing its transformation. Through the company's One Timken approach, employees work across the organization to innovate and deliver greater value. Timken's culture and core values – Safety, Ethics & Integrity, Quality, Excellence and Teamwork – guide how that work gets done.


Forbes America's Best Companies 2027 list recognizes 500 companies based on more than 120 metrics from a dozen data providers. Forbes assessed tens of millions of data points across a range of factors, including financial performance, customer sentiment, employee ratings, cybersecurity and sustainability.


***About The Timken Company*** The Timken Company (NYSE: TKR;[www.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821306-1&h=1899308766&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.timken.com%2F&a=www.timken.com) ), a leader in advanced motion technology, designs and manufactures highly engineered systems and components for customers in strategic end markets, including aerospace and defense, power and electrification, and automation and industrial solutions. With more than 125 years of specialized expertise and a multinational presence, Timken is a trusted partner worldwide, innovating and powering performance across the application lifecycle. The company posted $4.6 billion in sales in 2025 and employs approximately 19,000 people, operating from 45 countries. Learn more at[www.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821306-1&h=1899308766&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.timken.com%2F&a=www.timken.com) or[@TheTimkenCompany](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821306-1&h=968704718&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fthe-timken-company%2Fposts%2F%3FfeedView%3Dall&a=%40TheTimkenCompany) .
